about_the_game:
Welcome to The Fog’s End: a roadhouse an intersection of virtual dimensions where there are many thirsty travelers.

You have many beers to serve to survive the waves of infinite customers.

Some customers will be nice. Some customers will demand cigars, VIP service, video games or mechanical bull riding.

Some customers will be trouble-makers. Those customers, you gotta beat up.

VIPs are vital for your roadhouse. Send them on quests, or gamble-dice to win cocktail infusions for your custom cocktail, or hire them to staff, to help out on the busy nights. Each VIPs has their own attributes, roles, and special bonuses. Some are even famous historical figures. 

Some of the worst customers are super-drunk aliens that phase in and out of reality portals.

If these aliens can break your shielding, they'll basically wreck your roadhouse, causing you ton of costs in damages.

Use your VIPs with smarts to keep these dastardly drunk aliens contained!

No one ever bartended like this before, in gaming.

Each drink is a performance in The Fog’s End. You’ll need some good flair to impress your VIPs. Toss the glass, spin it, balance it on your arm. Pour it perfectly. And your ingredients have to be up to snuff to, as only the highest quality cocktails can trigger an Infusion, where your VIP remembers he or she is a famous figure from history!

24 kinds of beer. 24 kinds of wine. 100 different spirits. 99 different beverages and juices. 85 kinds of sweeteners, mixes and syrups. No game has ever had any bar anywhere near as stocked as yours, with 333 possible ingredients in the roadhouse.

Utilizing an powerful Signature Cocktail designer, the amount of drinks you can create is almost endless. Only have some lime juice, maple syrup and gin? Don’t worry about it! Your friendly Mixologist-3000 robot will come up with something!

Our cocktail creator offers near infinite possibilities. You may be able to generate your very own original and delicious legendary drink that you could make in the real world if you have the same ingredients. Millions of possible cocktail inventions are possible in your roadhouse!

As the days go on, you’ll need an increasingly a better roadhouse to entice fog-wanderers to stop by. Through your staff, you can spend money on upgrading your roadhouse: show lights, plants, seating, appliances, a games room, O2 bar, karaoke, and first-class VIP room for your most famous guests. The day time is for casual prepping for the night time.

Every day you'll be able to get a new blueprint card rewards. Collect and build enough matching upgrades in a set will unlock powerful new amenities that'll impress even the most skilled and famous VIP guests!

You have a magic interdimensional jukebox that can bring in over 120 songs from alternate dimensions, and multiversal cable, to watch countless random strange clips that will give you Inspirations to use for your cocktail creation. Design an original, delicious, wunder-cocktail that'll elevate your VIP's attributes!

If push comes to shove, you’ll have to deliver an occasional beat-down to keep the unruly guests chilled and reasonable. Punch, kick, and throw unruly guests down the stairs to prevent a giant bar fight from breaking out, wrecking your roadhouse!

short_description: Bartend and bar-brawl in your own multiversal roadhouse! Be the manager to summon staff, or the cooler to rough up the ruffians,or the bartender to craft magical cocktails. Collect rare upgrades & VIPs! Every night pulls in unique wanderers: some are famous,some are fun,& some are very drunk aliens!
